_format: camera_id -> {lines: ["x1,y1,x2,y2:POS:NEG[:mx,my]", ...], notes}. Coordinates are normalized [0,1]; POS is the direction assigned when a track crosses onto the line's positive side, NEG the reverse. Optional mx,my is the calibrated flow motion: tracks moving against it cannot fire this line (prevents the opposite flow's distant vehicles from miscounting).

tva43.notes: Motion-calibrated 2026-08-09 (src.perception.calibrate_line, 15-min daytime clip): one line per flow, perpendicular to observed motion, motion-gated. Direction mapping verified from daylight frames (up-frame = EB) - evidence in outputs/review/direction-verification/. Ungated per-flow lines overcounted ~2x (opposite flow crossing in the far field); motion gating restores plausible totals - see PR.
